papers.title: Image and Video Mining through Online Learning
papers.abstract: Within the field of image and video recognition, the traditional approach is a dataset split into fixed training and test partitions. However, the labelling of the training set is time-consuming, especially as datasets grow in size and complexity. Furthermore, this approach is not applicable to the home user, who wants to intuitively group their media without tirelessly labelling the content. Our interactive approach is able to iteratively cluster classes of images and video. Our approach is based around the concept of an image signature which, unlike a standard bag of words model, can express co-occurrence statistics as well as symbol frequency. We efficiently compute metric distances between signatures despite their inherent high dimensionality and provide discriminative feature selection, to allow common and distinctive elements to be identified from a small set of user labelled examples. These elements are then accentuated in the image signature to increase similarity between examples and pull correct classes together. By repeating this process in an online learning framework, the accuracy of similarity increases dramatically despite labelling only a few training examples. To demonstrate that the approach is agnostic to media type and features used, we evaluate on three image datasets (15 scene, Caltech101 and FG-NET), a mixed text and image dataset (ImageTag), a dataset used in active learning (Iris) and on three action recognition datasets (UCF11, KTH and Hollywood2). On the UCF11 video dataset, the accuracy is 86.7% despite using only 90 labelled examples from a dataset of over 1200 videos, instead of the standard 1122 training videos. The approach is both scalable and efficient, with a single iteration over the full UCF11 dataset of around 1200 videos taking approximately 1 minute on a standard desktop machine.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论图像视频的在线聚类，与有限元代理模型无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on image/video clustering via online learning and does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization under constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少图像视频标注成本，实现交互式聚类
summary_zh.method: 基于图像签名的在线学习框架，迭代优化类间相似性
summary_zh.result: 少量标注即可达到高准确率，UCF11用90样本达86.7%
summary_zh.validation: 在多个图像和视频数据集上评估，对比标准方法

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the labeling effort for image and video datasets, enabling interactive clustering for home users.
summary_en.method: An online learning framework using image signatures that capture co-occurrence and frequency, with efficient metric distance computation and discriminative feature selection.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves 86.7% accuracy on UCF11 with only 90 labeled examples out of 1200+ videos, demonstrating scalability and efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on seven datasets including image (15 scene, Caltech101, FG-NET), text-image (ImageTag), active learning (Iris), and video action recognition (UCF11, KTH, Hollywood2) datasets.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification for generalized Langevin dynamics
papers.abstract: We present efficient finite difference estimators for goal-oriented sensitivity indices with applications to the generalized Langevin equation (GLE). In particular, we apply these estimators to analyze an extended variable formulation of the GLE where other well known sensitivity analysis techniques such as the likelihood ratio method are not applicable to key parameters of interest. These easily implemented estimators are formed by coupling the nominal and perturbed dynamics appearing in the finite difference through a common driving noise, or common random path. After developing a general framework for variance reduction via coupling, we demonstrate the optimality of the common random path coupling in the sense that it produces a minimal variance surrogate for the difference estimator relative to sampling dynamics driven by independent paths. In order to build intuition for the common random path coupling, we evaluate the efficiency of the proposed estimators for a comprehensive set of examples of interest in particle dynamics. These reduced variance difference estimators are also a useful tool for performing global sensitivity analysis and for investigating non-local perturbations of parameters, such as increasing the number of Prony modes active in an extended variable GLE.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要针对粒子动力学的敏感性分析，不涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA context, no surrogate modelling for expensive simulations, no constraint handling, method specific to Langevin dynamics not transferable to implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算广义Langevin动力学的目标敏感性指标
summary_zh.method: 通过公共随机路径耦合并使用有限差分估计器降低方差
summary_zh.result: 耦合方法在方差最小化意义上达到最优，并通过实例验证效率提升
summary_zh.validation: 在粒子动力学数值示例中验证了估计器的效率

summary_en.motivation: Develop efficient finite difference estimators for goal-oriented sensitivity indices in generalized Langevin dynamics where likelihood ratio methods fail.
summary_en.method: Couple nominal and perturbed dynamics via common random path or common noise to form variance-reduced finite difference estimators.
summary_en.result: The common random path coupling is proven optimal in minimizing estimator variance, and demonstrated effective on a comprehensive set of particle dynamics examples.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proof of optimality combined with numerical benchmarks on generalized Langevin equation examples.

papers.title: Efficient batch-sequential Bayesian optimization with moments of truncated Gaussian vectors
papers.abstract: We deal with the efficient parallelization of Bayesian global optimization algorithms, and more specifically of those based on the expected improvement criterion and its variants. A closed form formula relying on multivariate Gaussian cumulative distribution functions is established for a generalized version of the multipoint expected improvement criterion. In turn, the latter relies on intermediate results that could be of independent interest concerning moments of truncated Gaussian vectors. The obtained expansion of the criterion enables studying its differentiability with respect to point batches and calculating the corresponding gradient in closed form. Furthermore , we derive fast numerical approximations of this gradient and propose efficient batch optimization strategies. Numerical experiments illustrate that the proposed approaches enable computational savings of between one and two order of magnitudes, hence enabling derivative-based batch-sequential acquisition function maximization to become a practically implementable and efficient standard.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了高效的批量贝叶斯优化方法，可用于代理模型辅助的昂贵仿真优化，对用户的FEA替代模型方向具有参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design problems; it is a general methodological study without domain-specific constraints or validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高贝叶斯优化中批量序列采样的效率
summary_zh.method: 利用截断高斯向量矩的闭合形式计算多点期望改进准则及其梯度
summary_zh.result: 实现了梯度驱动的批量采集函数优化，计算速度提升一到两个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准测试上验证算法效率

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of batch-sequential sampling in Bayesian global optimization.
summary_en.method: Derive closed-form expressions for moments of truncated Gaussian vectors to compute the multipoint expected improvement criterion and its gradient.
summary_en.result: Gradient-based batch acquisition optimization achieves one to two orders of magnitude computational savings.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard benchmark functions demonstrate efficiency gains.

papers.title: On the texture, phase and tensile properties of commercially pure Ti produced via selective laser melting assisted by static magnetic field

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制备钛合金的织构与拉伸性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学植入物核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on texture and tensile properties of CP-Ti under static magnetic field during SLM, but does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索静磁场辅助SLM对纯钛织构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在SLM过程中施加静磁场，制备纯钛样品并分析织构和拉伸性能。
summary_zh.result: 静磁场促进了特定织构的形成并提高了拉伸强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD和拉伸测试验证了织构和力学性能的变化。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to investigate the effect of a static magnetic field applied during selective laser melting on the crystallographic texture and mechanical properties of commercially pure titanium.
summary_en.method: Commercially pure titanium samples were fabricated via selective laser melting with an external static magnetic field, and their texture, phase composition, and tensile properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: The static magnetic field promoted the formation of a specific crystallographic texture and improved the tensile strength of the SLM-produced titanium.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through X-ray diffraction for texture analysis and tensile testing for mechanical properties.
